items.title: Developmental Complexity CEUs
items.summary: Ten sessions on how developmental difference changes ordinary therapy. Use this set when the child is under 6, autistic, gifted or highly capable, or has an intellectual disability, and when you are adapting pace, language, or caregiver involvement.

items.title: Behavior Modification / ABA
items.summary: A functional view of behavior for use inside a CSC therapy hour: what happens before, what the behavior does for the child, and a replacement they can actually perform. This is not training to deliver high-hour ABA. Many-hour ABA programs are outside CSC's scope.

items.title: Feeding Disorders and Cultural Eating / GI
items.summary: Feeding disorders, including ARFID, the cultural meaning of food, and GI illness as it shows up at the table and at school. Use this before you treat a narrow diet as defiance or import a generic eating-disorder frame.
topics: When to involve dietitian, GI, or speech

items.title: Chronic Illness
items.summary: The recorded set for cancer, sickle cell disease, cystic fibrosis, and diabetes. Start here before a first visit when the referral comes from oncology, hematology, pulmonology, or endocrine for one of these illnesses.

items.title: Additional topics
items.summary: The longer set covering OCD, encopresis, tics, and the ADHD differential. Use the ADHD differential material before you settle an inattention story — absence seizures and medication effects belong in that differential.
